notes.title: BAFL just turned 2! And soon with online multiplayer!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34635421/7864b3347c4815c123dc03fb7da9f0fe44780b7a.jpg[/img]

On October 18th 2017, BAFL released on PC. But what is BAFL you might ask? BAFL: Brakes Are For Losers is a hectic top-down racing game inspired by classics of the genre like Super Off Road on SNES & Super Sprint on Amiga. But, what makes it unique, as the title suggests it, is that you [b]CAN’T[/b] brake!

To be the best in BAFL, you’ll have to use your constant speed in the most efficient way to keep momentum & not crash into walls. This is a strong & unique concept for a racing game. The game is not about handling acceleration & braking at the good timing but rather about going fast without taking too much damage to optimize your ratio damage/distance. Each car has health that lowers every time you crash into a wall or hit an opponent & you can stop for a few seconds at pitstops to repair. 

Will you be the careful driver that repairs more frequently to avoid getting your car destroyed or the mad driver that risks it all not to lose time repairing?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34635421/e89a7d6bd674c983c1a343d7d184ec9b038d0fa8.jpg[/img]
The game has several modes:

- A [b]Championship[/b] mode you can play solo or multiplayer versus fierce AIs
- A [b]Time attack[/b] mode with an online leaderboard
- A [b]Perfect race[/b] mode where you have to do the maximum distance without touching any walls
- A [b]Custom[/b] mode where you can create your own championships with your own ruleset with your friends

One cool feature about BAFL is also that the game has simple controls & you only need half of a controller to play! This is great because you can play BAFL [b]up to 8 players[/b] with 4 controllers only!

Speaking of multiplayer, we also want to remind you that the new [b]Remote Control System[/b] created by Steam to allow [b]online multiplayer[/b] with local multiplayer games is coming! That means you will be able to create big tournaments with your friends from home, sit in your own comfortable couch!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34635421/f07b093155faf74e712a0ffa37584f6e6401acb8.jpg[/img]

Now that you know more about the game we invite you to go check BAFL Steam page & watch their [b]AMAZING 80es style[/b] release trailer with guaranteed fake mullet cuts, floopy disks & belt bags!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/573070/BAFL__Brakes_Are_For_Losers/

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MjVSxgFcfug
And… If you’re fast enough (it’s a racing game after all), [b]win a key[/b] of the game by adding one of these codes in Steam, good luck drivers!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34635421/4f6097a2f07bffad29b78efa6a60aa6315c972eb.jpg[/img]

Hi pilots!

To celebrate [b]BAFL release[/b] on [b]Nintendo Switch[/b], we're doing a special [b]stream[/b] on [b]Twitch[/b], [b]Youtube[/b] & [b]Facebook[/b]! Alain, our beloved [b]developer[/b] of the game & Mickael, Playdius' [b]community manager[/b] will introduce you the [b]main modes[/b] in the game!

Then, it will be time to get on the starting line, they'll [b]compete[/b] in a [b]championship[/b] to see who's the better [b]pilot[/b]! (Spoiler: one has many more hours on the game :p)

Maybe some [b]free play[/b] with more players after that!

The stream is scheduled for [b]6PM GMT+1[/b], find us on:
[b]Twitch[/b]: https://www.twitch.tv/playdiusgames
[b]Youtube[/b]: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCMRoOwD0UfPzNqCevbkKfaQ
[b]Facebook[/b]: https://www.facebook.com/PlaydiusGames/

Because good news never come alone, the [b]game on PC will be 40% off[/b] during [b]one week[/b]! We've also done a [b]patch[/b], mainly to add [b]optimizations[/b] made for the Switch to the [b]PC version[/b]!

Patch log:
- optimization: various performance optimizations (including new light system at night)
- optimization: greatly reduced application loading time
- hints: new cinematics the first time in the menu track, to show the different parts of the game
- hints: new "double tap" tutorial to pop before harder races, unless you've already used it often enough
- fixes: AI cars could trigger the perfect lap achievement (oops)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 is live!
notes.notes:
[b]What’s new[/b]

BAFL has been out for a month now, it’s time to update to version 1.0.1!

We’ve added or changed some features and did some balancing, here’s the full list:

- in Time Attack you can now race against the dev's ghost!
- the quick-turn hint is now shown in the how-to screen
- in quick race mode, in-between rankings now show a general ranking instead of the last race's rankings
- money bonus now appears more often
- Vegas track: short cut through the grass slows you down a little less (it's now worth it in time attack!)

And this update also solves a few bugs! (see patch log at the end).

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29142966/b65c96b07a4ff917ef129bef996bb9d1d9dd6828.png[/img]


[b]What’s coming[/b]

It’s time to announce some of the next steps to go for BAFL’s development!

For now, the next milestone is to port the game on Mac, we hope to make it available as soon as possible!

We’re also working on porting the game on consoles. The console versions will add new content to the game: extra cars, extra tracks… If you have any wishes or suggestions, now is a good time to speak.

And note that, once ready for consoles, this will come as a free update for PC users too!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29142966/3fa23fa1ce1b811959060b6969d8fee44d9c8bdd.jpg[/img]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Thanks to your feedbacks, we’ve identified various bugs that we’ve worked on fixing, here are the main issues that are corrected in this patch: 


- bug fix: fixed the bug where a car could remain wrecked if it exploded while being thrown out of the pits
- bug fix: the "win all races" achievements now work properly
- bug fix: night can now happen in quick race mode
- bug fix: pixelization could remain active at the end of the race. It shouldn't any more (hard to reproduce)
- various graphics & interface fixes

BAFL is coming to PC/Steam next Wednesday, October 18th. But we are so excited to share our hard work with you that [b]we decided to release the demo no later than today![/b]



                                     [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29142966/b6e6a06a9095e4d04c8c1f8665d1f4efe38d63fe.gif[/img]


This free demo offers you a small tour of BAFL. It includes 1 track for Time-Attack or Perfect Race and a 3-track championship for up to 4 players (instead of 8 in the full game).

Give it a try today and get an exclusive preview of BAFL before its release.

And if you feel confident with your skills (and we bet you do, haha!), you can join our [b]Pre-Release-Time-Attack-Demo-Week-End-Contest-With-Cars-And-NO-BRAKES![/b]

The challenge is quite simple: climb up to the top 10 of the Time-Attack leaderboard and you will win a free key for the full game.

Competition starts now and ends on Sunday, 11:59PM Pacific Time (GMT-7)

Winners will be announced here on Monday.

Have fun with BAFL this week-end, and spread the word!
Feel free to also post your BAFL couch parties on Twitter or Facebook.

[b]And add us to your Steam wishlist![/b]

Thanks!

notes.title: Grab your wheel, BAFL is bringing back good old arcade fun on October 18th!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29142966/037fffc8c8d07a82e2d27f109fbfd82c1b680739.png[/img]

We are thrilled to announce that BAFL - Brakes Are For Losers will be released here on Steam on [b]October 18th[/b] !

BAFL - Brakes Are For Losers is a [b]good-old arcade style top-down hectic racing game[/b]. With cars. !

It offers 10 unique tracks inspired by the [b]pop culture of the 80’s and 90’s[/b] and full of funny details and surprising events. Each track takes you to a different setting, from peaceful caribbean island to hellish underground, from fabulous Las Vegas all the way to the Moon! 

[i]Here’s a short gameplay footage featuring “The Brake Lagoon” track.	[/i]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rN6gVfVfpzE
 
BAFL is all about [b]pure arcade fun[/b]. Challenge your friends, pick a funky car and outrun them thanks to your driving skills or dirty tricks. Ram them out of your way or pick up bonuses to wreck them. 

Gather [b]up to 8 people[/b] on the same screen, compete in championships, upgrade your cars. And break friendships.

BAFL also offers a [b]challenging solo experience[/b] with championships against fierce AIs and special modes such as [b]Time Attack[/b] or [b]Perfect Race[/b]. Train and compete against the best players worldwide thanks to the global ghost system and make your way to the top of the [b]world leaderboards[/b]! 

BAFL is a simple invitation to dive in a [b]state of the art old-school epic racing game[/b]. With no freaking brakes!

[b][list]
[*]Old-School Top-Down Action
[*]10 Unique Themed Tracks
[*]8 Funky Cars
[*]Local Multiplayer, up to 8 Players
[*]Solo and Multiplayer Championships with Car Upgrades
[*]In-Race Events and Dirty Tricks
[*]Time Attack with World Ladders and Ghosts
[*]Badass Soundtrack
[*]No. Brakes.
[/list][/b]

BAFL - Brakes Are For Losers will be available in 10 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Russian, Portuguese/Brazilian, Chinese, Korean and Japanese.

It will be sold at a price of 9,99€ / 9,99$ on Steam.

Remember to add us to your wishlist!

notes.title: Warm-up Lap #6 - Jurassic Brake!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29142966/8372a60f77c5916b458852d965a16e812df9cca0.png[/img]

Lap #6 : Jurassic Brake! Inside this well-known dinosaur park, you'll have to deal with the comings and goings of the visitors' monorail that randomly cross the road during the race!

[b]What's new:[/b]
[list]
[*]New track: Jurassic Brake! Don't disturb the dinosaurs nor the visitors in this track 65 million years in the making!

[*]Cash pick-up now appears on top on the car which pick it up to avoid confusion

[*]If you keep getting "Wrong Way" in tracks with crossings (such as Hell or Space Station) an arrow will show you where to go

[*]New and updated sounds for various map events

[*]An audio manager has been added in the options of the pause menu!
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Due to an update, the flag's counters may have been reset. To get your flags back, you'll just have to visit each race circuit once & the unlocked flags will be instantly added back as they were before.

notes.title: Warm-up Lap #2 - First Update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29142966/8372a60f77c5916b458852d965a16e812df9cca0.png[/img]
Lap #2 - Fresh new track: Winter is braking! You'll have to slide your way through an icy road while your Adhesion stat is ignored. Stay frosty & manage your drifts to master this race circuit!

What's new:
- New "Ice" track! Challenges for this track can be found in the hard part (the third part to the left) of the main menu (you'll have to unlock it first!)
- New explosion animation
- Skid marks now take the color of certain elements you pass through (e.g. oil, grass, ice)

Fixes:
- Fixed: in Time Attack, before the race starts, the ghost car sometimes appeared ahead of the start line
- Fixed: left-hand keyboard controls now can be used in menus
- Fixed: cars can no longer get stuck in the borders of the track (hopefully :P)
- Fixed: various UI issues
- Fixed: leaderboard used to freeze if there were no entries
- Fixed: in Perfect Race, boosts are no longer displayed above the car. You can still use them as much as you want, though it's not recommended if you don't want to hit the track. ;)

Known issues:
- Sometimes when playing a Time Attack, the car just stops. We're still hunting that one down. If you encounter it, please report it with as much detail as you can.
- Car choosing screen/shop is broken when playing on a 4:3 screen (but who does? :P)

Stay tuned for more updates, and see you on the tracks.

notes.title: Warm-up lap #1 : BAFL is now in BETA!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29142966/8372a60f77c5916b458852d965a16e812df9cca0.png[/img]
BAFL - Brakes Are For Losers is a top-down, single-screen racing game created as a tribute to Old School Arcade Games such as Super Sprint or Indy Heat. It offers challenging solo and multiplayer fun for up to 8 players!

The game is now officially entering BETA!

This week is the first lap of the BAFL warm-up race and every new week, we'll distribute beta keys for new players to join in. In order to access the beta, just fill in the form to have a chance to receive a steam key. 
We’ll also drop some steam codes on the social media! Stay tuned!
You'll maybe have the chance to be one of the first pilots in the BAFL race!

[h1]The sign-up form is available using [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdDFzHlappfZiyiazhlGx8bZABUg2nCRqrA3GHeLQzqipsj9w/viewform?usp=sf_link]this link[/url] [/h1]

Each week will feature one update. We will be adding new tracks along the way to keep our racers fit. 
Challenge your friends and try to climb to the top of the world leaderboard! Be careful though, leaderboards are subject to a reset during the beta if balancing updates happen!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/573070/discussions/0/1457328927827358868/]A new discussion[/url] has been added where you can discuss with other players, share experiences & ideas! Since the game is multiplayer, you can also share your most frenzied races & your BAFL party setups.
Join the madness on our social medias using #BAFLParty. :)

[url=https://twitter.com/Baflgame]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/BAFLGame]Facebook[/url]

Feel free to use F12 while playing to take screenshots & use Shift + Tab to access and post on the community hub in just a few clicks!

If you encounter bugs/glitches while playing, press F1 directly in the game. A mighty automated command will report the issue to the developers. Bug reports will be preferably sent this way.

Now take a sit on your bucket seat, place yourself on the starting line & GOOOO... No brakes allowed!!

Have fun playing BAFL!

Get ready for some crazy racing for up to 8 players with no brakes!

If you wonder what BAFL is, ask your dad about Super Sprint, Indy Heat or Super Off Road he will tell you what single screen video game racing is all about! 
Skills, Skills and pure instant fun.

BAFL is currently being developed by a small dev team and coming to your computer this fall.
